wear: Fresh cassette → worn tape: RF loss, fine noise and more dropouts.
colour: Aligned colour → soft colour spilling to the right of bright edges.
unstable: Steady picture → shaky vertical edges and top flagging. TV horizontal lock can hide some movement.
smear: Adds a moving mistracking band with stretched/repeated lines and colour loss.
crease: Adds local tape speed errors, duplicated lines and horizontal tears.
